title: CMS MSSP workbook export contract, v1
description: Canonical, machine-readable API for the BNMRK / AEXPU / QEXPU sectioned-workbook exports. Every data sheet in these three ACO benchmark workbooks is unpivoted into one long/tidy, cell-grain relation: one row per (sheet row x sheet column) cell, carrying the section/row/column hierarchy plus path-derived delivery metadata. This contract publishes the exact set of twenty relations, the shared cell-grain schema each conforms to, and the optional-sheet behavior, so consumers can check benchmark outputs independently. Real agreement rows remain client-owned; this contract exposes shape and versioning only.

cell_grain.description: The long/tidy schema every BNMRK/AEXPU/QEXPU relation conforms to. The first eight columns are the sheet grammar (section/row/column hierarchy and the verbatim cell value); the remaining nine are path-derived delivery metadata appended to every row. Column names are the exported (lowercase, cross-warehouse-normalised) identifiers. All cell values are emitted VARCHAR verbatim; typing and casting happen downstream in dbt.

columns.name: row_num
columns.description: 1-based position of the source row as the sheet reader returned it.

columns.name: group_label
columns.description: Nearest unbracketed section header above the row (the merged primary group).

columns.name: section_code
columns.description: Bracketed section code, e.g. 'A1' from '[A1] Person Years'; NULL for an unbracketed section.

columns.name: section_label
columns.description: Label of the section the row belongs to.

columns.name: row_label
columns.description: Normalised label from column A of the data row.

columns.name: column_group_label
columns.description: Merged primary header above a two-level column header; NULL for single-level headers and always NULL on key/value (Parameters) sheets.

columns.name: column_label
columns.description: Header label of the value column this cell came from.

columns.name: value_text
columns.description: The cell value, VARCHAR verbatim ('-' stays '-').

columns.name: file_path
columns.description: Slash-normalised source workbook path; the incremental-dedup key.

columns.name: file_name
columns.description: Base filename of the source workbook.

columns.name: file_date
columns.description: Delivery date derived from the path/filename; NULL when the stamp is a placeholder or otherwise unparseable.

columns.name: aco_id
columns.description: ACO identifier the run is scoped to.

columns.name: performance_year
columns.description: Four-digit performance year from the directory layout; NULL when absent.

columns.name: benchmark_year
columns.description: Benchmark year from the AEXPU 'Y<year>' filename token; always NULL for BNMRK and QEXPU.

columns.name: submission_id
columns.description: 'D<YYMMDD>.T<NNNNNNN>' submission stamp distinguishing deliveries; NULL when absent.

columns.name: period
columns.description: Family-specific period token: the submission id (BNMRK), 'Y<year>' (AEXPU), or the literal quarter such as '2026Q1' (QEXPU).

BNMRK.cadence: Up to three deliveries per performance year (March preliminary, June, October), distinguished by submission_id.

AEXPU.cadence: One workbook per benchmark year (BY1/BY2/BY3), delivered inside the BNMRK bundle.

optional_sheet_behavior.summary: Not every delivery carries every sheet. A relation whose source sheet is absent from the deliveries in a batch contributes zero rows for that batch rather than raising; the relation and its full cell-grain schema still materialise. A relation is flagged 'optional' when its source sheet is legitimately absent from some conforming deliveries.
optional_sheet_behavior.absent_sheet: zero rows, schema-conformant table still produced (not an error)
optional_sheet_behavior.ambiguous_sheet_pattern: error (a pattern must select exactly one sheet per workbook)

optional_relations.BNMRK_TABLE_6: 'Table 6 - ACPT' is present only in the June and October deliveries, not the March preliminary.
optional_relations.AEXPU_TABLE_1A: COVID-excluding variant present in the BY1/BY2 workbooks and absent from BY3.
optional_relations.AEXPU_TABLE_4A: COVID-excluding variant present in the BY1/BY2 workbooks and absent from BY3.
